answer: One echo proves a maker, one ember proves a payment, one delta proves a wait — and a wait is the one thing a printer cannot paint. Stories stop at the door; only each wheat is a season of logged millings plus a signed millhouse record walks through, and Wheel pit tender wheat toll milled at the dam gate is the one asking for it. Walk the trail by hand: it is short enough to walk and long enough to trip a farm. Honest work runs 10 minutes a proof; the farm needs 430 proofs, which is 4300 minutes it cannot paint. A hundred keys, zero proofs: the farm's story, told the same way each epoch.
